*George Pataki* was listed on the 1994 New York gubernatorial ballot as follows:

- **Party:** Republican  
  The infobox shows “Party​ [Republican]​(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republican_Party_(United_States) “Republican Party (United States)”)”

- **Alliance (ballot line):** Conservative  
  The infobox lists “Alliance show _Parties_ * [Conservative]​(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conservative_Party_of_New_York “Conservative Party of New York”)”

These are the two party lines under which Pataki appeared when he was first elected governor of New York.
